evidence_for_replacement: Candidate Observed MDD improves by 17.02–25.07pp in all five windows.
Total return and CAGR are positive in all periods; candidate total return is higher in 4/5.
Candidate win rate and mean realized trade return exceed CONTROL in all five windows.
Average capital utilization is lower in all five; cash shortage remains diagnostic only.
counter_evidence: P2-1 candidate total return is lower by 9.7924pp and CAGR lower by 1.7551pp.
Candidate worst single trade is more negative in every period: -44.3903% vs CONTROL -35.0608% to -39.1249%.
+50%/+100% winner counts fall in most windows; upside preservation has a trade-off.
Windows overlap and are retrospective; they are not five independent tests or fresh future evidence.
basis: V2 frozen contract prioritizes LARGE_LOSS_MINIMIZATION, then PRESERVE_SUFFICIENT_UPSIDE. This recommendation weighs portfolio MDD improvements against the stated counter-evidence; no new threshold was added.
